recipe.title: Dump-and-Go Crockpot Creamy Tuscan Chicken
recipe.summary: Tender slow-cooked chicken with sun-dried tomatoes, spinach, Parmesan, and a creamy Greek-yogurt sauce for approximately 52 grams of protein and 355 calories.
recipe.story: The chicken and seasonings cook all day without any stovetop preparation. Greek yogurt, Parmesan, and spinach go in after the heat is lowered so the sauce stays creamy instead of separating.
ingredients: 36 ounces raw boneless skinless chicken breast
2 ounces dry-packed sun-dried tomatoes, thinly sliced
1 1/2 cups nonfat plain Greek yogurt, at room temperature
4 ounces reduced-fat cream cheese, softened and cubed
instructions: In the morning, place the chicken in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the bone broth, sun-dried tomatoes, Italian seasoning, granulated garlic, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 to 8 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F and is tender.
At night, transfer the chicken to a plate and switch the slow cooker to WARM.
Whisk the softened cream cheese into the hot cooking liquid until smooth, then stir in the spinach until wilted.
Place the Greek yogurt in a bowl and whisk in 1/2 cup of the warm sauce a little at a time. Stir the tempered yogurt and Parmesan into the slow cooker. Do not boil.
Slice or shred the chicken, return it to the sauce, and divide into 6 equal servings.
tips: Use dry-packed sun-dried tomatoes. Oil-packed tomatoes add substantially more calories unless they are drained and measured carefully.
Bring the Greek yogurt close to room temperature and temper it with warm sauce to reduce curdling.
Do not add the yogurt in the morning because dairy can separate during a long cook.
Serve as written or add a separately measured vegetable. Pasta, rice, or bread would increase the listed calories.
Nutrition is approximate and varies by brand.
